GLOSSARY.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Tikanöx ri tzij pa pwaq (ej. yakoj, k'as, rajil)...

emergency-fund.EXPLANATION: Pwaq yakon choj richin yabil, ruk'ojlem ch'ich' o sachoj samaj. Ütz 3 k'a 6 ik' gastos.
emergency-fund.EXAMPLE: We agastos e Q3,000 pa jun ik', 3 ik' e Q9,000.

micro-expenses.SHORT_DESC: Ch'uti loq'oj q'ij q'ij man netamäx ta.
micro-expenses.EXPLANATION: Loq'oj q'ij q'ij nkisärisaj ri apwaq akuchi ntel nimaläj rajil pa jun juna'.
micro-expenses.EXAMPLE: We nak'ës Q20 pa q'ij, ntel Q600 ik'ik' chuqa' Q7,200 juna'.

rule-50-30-20.SHORT_DESC: Man k'ayew ta jachonïk apwaq ik'ik'.
rule-50-30-20.EXPLANATION: 50% rajowaxik, 30% rayb'äl, 20% yakoj pwaq chuqa' tojonïk k'as.
rule-50-30-20.EXAMPLE: Pa Q5,000: Q2,500 rajowaxik, Q1,500 rayb'äl, Q1,000 yakoj.

compound-interest.SHORT_DESC: Ral pwaq chi rij ral pwaq xch'ak chik.
compound-interest.EXPLANATION: Toq ri ach'akoj ntz'aqat ruk'in ri apwaq ruxe'el richin npoq'an chik.
compound-interest.EXAMPLE: Yakoj Q1,000 pa 5% nuch'äk Q50 ri nab'ey juna', chuqa' 5% chi rij Q1,050 ri ruka'n.

full-payer.SHORT_DESC: Winaq nutöj ronojel ri tarjeta ik'ik'.
full-payer.EXPLANATION: Nutöj ronojel ri k'as chuwäch ri q'ij richin man nutöj ta ral pwaq.
full-payer.EXAMPLE: Xaloq' Q800 pa ri ik', natöj choj Q800 pa ri q'ij.

inflation.SHORT_DESC: Jotolïk rajil q'ij q'ij chuqa' sachoj uchuq'a' pwaq.
inflation.EXPLANATION: Toq ri jastaq njote' rajil pa ronojel q'ij, ri pwaq yakon pa warab'äl manäq chik nuloq'.
inflation.EXAMPLE: We jun wa'ïk k'o Q30 kan chuqa' wakamin Q33, ri jotolïk xux 10%.

liquidity.EXPLANATION: Ri apwaq pa CURBI chaq'ij aninek yatikïr nakusaj, xa jun jay man aninek ta nak'ayij.
liquidity.EXAMPLE: Pwaq k'o pa acolar nkiya' aninek pwaq chawa.

zero-based-budget.SHORT_DESC: Naya' rusamaj ronojel centavo nok pe.
zero-based-budget.EXPLANATION: Ronojel quetzal k'o rusamaj akuchi ri apwaq ntel cero toq xajäj ronojel gastos chuqa' yakoj.
zero-based-budget.EXAMPLE: We nach'äk Q4,000, naya' rusamaj ronojel ri Q4,000.

regla-50-30-20.TITLE: Ri regla 50 / 30 / 20 richin nacholmirisaj apwaq
regla-50-30-20.SUMMARY: Tetamäx jachonïk pwaq akuchi man nak'ës ta ri rayb'äl.
regla-50-30-20.ACTION_TIP: Katb'e pa K'amb'äl Retamab'al richin nachol apwaq.

fondo-emergencia.TITLE: Ri Nab'ey Yakoj pa K'ayewal
fondo-emergencia.SUMMARY: Rutzijol achike ruma ri yakoj pwaq nuchajij awi' chuwäch k'as.
fondo-emergencia.ACTION_TIP: Tachapa' ruk'in jun ti yakoj: tayaka' Q200 re ik' re'.

gastos-hormiga.TITLE: Q'atonïk Ch'uti Gastos chuqa' aninek loq'oj
gastos-hormiga.SUMMARY: Ketamäx ri ch'uti loq'oj nkisach apwaq.
gastos-hormiga.ACTION_TIP: Tatz'eta' ri asuscripciones chuqa' tayuja' ri man nakusaj ta.

tarjetas-credito.TITLE: Tarjetas de Crédito: Ütz kusanïk majun ral pwaq
tarjetas-credito.SUMMARY: Takusaj ri utzil richin tarjeta majun tojonïk ral pwaq.
tarjetas-credito.ACTION_TIP: Tatz'ib'aj ri q'ij richin natöj chuwäch ri q'ij.

metodo-bola-de-nieve.TITLE: Ri Na'oj Bola de Nieve richin tojonïk k'as
metodo-bola-de-nieve.SUMMARY: Ruk'ojlemal cholajem richin nak'ïs ronojel ri ak'as.
metodo-bola-de-nieve.ACTION_TIP: Tatz'ib'aj ri ak'as chuqa' tatöj nab'ey ri mas ti k'as.

interes-compuesto.TITLE: Ri Ral Pwaq Poq'näq chuqa' jikïl yakoj
interes-compuesto.SUMMARY: Achike rub'anïk ri ral pwaq nunimirisaj ri apwaq pa juna'.
interes-compuesto.ACTION_TIP: Tayaka' pwaq q'ij q'ij o ik'ik' stape' ti pwaq.
